episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: When a neighbor's au pair vanishes after asking to talk with her, Cecilie feels responsible — compelling her to personally investigate.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: After finding potential evidence, Cecile grows suspicious of Rasmus. Assigned to Ruby's case, police officer Aicha gets in over her head.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Cecilie secretly shares her discovery with Aicha. Viggo's friends pressure him to share inappropriate videos in their group chat.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: A break in the investigation leads Aicha to suspect the worst. Cecilie is suspicious of Mike after finding questionable information on his phone.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Katarina asks Cecilie to help her with a painful task. Aicha is told to drop the case, fueling her determination to dig deeper.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: As those around her twist the narrative to their benefit, Cecilie is left wondering who she's really dealing with.
